category: Embodiment fivefold descriptions / negative flow / missing heading
problem: The text moves from the title list to the dharma-embodiment explanation without an explicit third-reply heading in the e-text. The complete-enjoyment account says rgyun med, literally no flow, not unceasing. The dharma-activity account combines not arising with arising of its own force.

uncertainty: The contextual sense of rgyun med and the subject of the final teaching predicate remain provisional. Absence of a heading in the e-text does not prove absence in all witnesses.
action: Check the missing heading and compressed predicates against the print; do not silently normalize no flow to uninterrupted flow.

category: Final assembly / subject and speech attribution / alignment

Restore teacher/qualities and sphere/enlightened-intent phrases to their own source units in the decision log.

Do not identify protectors with unprinted names or address the warning to the present reader as the assistant's threat.
